title: TRICARE Prime One-Time Payment Amount
content:
**The calculation.** A one-time payment on a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment settles the annual installment whose coverage period begins latest at the whole annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement, less the payments standing against it, plus the refunds issued against the latest payment on that installment, never below zero, rounded to the cent, and pays nothing ahead. The annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement is the tier's annual individual fee for an individual arrangement and its annual family fee for a family arrangement.

## Condition - judgement - result

| Element | Reading |
|---|---|
| Owed | what the settled installment is owed |
| Received | the payments standing against the settled installment count as received |
| Owed again | refunds issued against the latest payment on the settled installment are owed again |
| One-time payment | what the settled installment is owed, less what counts as received, plus what is owed again, never below zero, plus the installments it pays ahead, rounded to the cent; it pays nothing ahead |

A monthly figure of the annual fee is one twelfth of it (the annual fee divided by 12), and a quarterly figure one quarter of it (divided by 4), each rounded to the cent. Months are calendar months, numbered continuously from January 2000; the current plan year is the calendar year containing today.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A, individual arrangement, annual fee 390.12)

| Payments standing against the annual installment | Refunds against its latest payment | One-time payment |
|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | 50.00 | 390.12 less 200.00 plus 50.00: 240.12 |
| 390.12 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 390.12 |
| 500.00 | 0.00 | below zero, so 0.00 |
